platform.name: CIVIC MAPS
platform.expansion: Centralised Integrated Visibility & Information for Compliance

easProjectId.note: Retain the currently assigned officer app EAS project ID for emaps.

command.role: dispatch, administration, supervision, compliance leadership deployment

notes: CIVIC MAPS is the umbrella platform identity and should not replace deployment-specific mobile product names.
commandmaps is the approved slug for CommandMAPS to avoid ambiguity with CIVIC.

municipalityToken.directRule: Use the validated registry slug only when length <= 47, it does not start with id-, and it is not a reserved acceptance token. Apply exact acceptanceAliases first.
municipalityToken.fallbackRule: id- followed by the immutable municipality UUID as 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters without hyphens; validate identity before route creation.
municipalityToken.ownershipRule: Persist token and canonical hostname against immutable municipality identity; enforce unique host ownership and reject conflicts.
municipalityToken.existingRecordPolicy: Preserve registry slugs, IDs, grants and data; reconcile incompatible routes explicitly with withdrawal, session invalidation and fresh readiness checks.
municipalityToken.acceptanceRule: Only the exact immutable UUID/slug pairs receive acceptance aliases; other alpha/beta slugs use the UUID-derived token.
